mechanics.summary: Janitor Plus monthly subscription offered from an Upgrade banner in the side menu; paywall shows one monthly price billed through Google Play, closable.
Janitor Plus adds to the Free tier: 5× context (longer chat memory), priority routing for faster replies, monthly swipes on frontier models, and a golden checkmark by the username.
The paywall implies Free users have smaller context and fewer or no frontier-model swipes. No chat limit, paywall or ad appeared after 1 pass of the core chat action.
Chats show a 'using janitor' badge for the model in use, and characters can be marked Proxy allowed, suggesting users can route chats through an outside proxy/API instead of the built-in model.
User-generated character marketplace: creators publish characters with handles, likes and chat counts; Hidden Gems promotes smaller creators; users can create their own characters.
